title: Artificial Superintelligence Alliance (FET) 📉 -1.2%

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What might the rise of artificial superintelligence mean for the future of human-machine collaboration?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: We're seeing early AGI prototypes using neural architecture search and transformer-based models, but true ASI remains speculative.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: The risk of misaligned goals in unregulated AI systems could lead to unintended societal harm and power imbalances.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are focusing on value alignment frameworks and transparency tools to ensure AI systems serve human interests.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI acts as a global collaborator in climate science and medicine could redefine progress for all.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of ASI depends on our ability to engineer with ethics, not just speed.
